services.name: Y Day Camp
services.desc: YMCA Day Camp gives young people an experience that can last a lifetime and inspires them to continue involvement with the Y for years to come. YMCA Day Camp activities allow children to create arts and crafts and explore science and technology. Campers can explore creativity, teamwork, and leadership in a wide range of physically active programs influencing lifelong healthy living. They have the opportunity to enjoy an outdoor environment where they develop an appreciation of nature. 4-year-old participants accepted at Holy Hill Area School District (HHASD), Kewaskum, and Lumen Christi ONLY for an additional fee. *Unit Camp structures are primarily used at Feith, Grafton, and Silverbrook
